masks: navigation_packets.build: universal legacy study_v2.transform before replay, plus motion/controller diagnostic removal before summaries; identical intact/irrelevant aliases share one request

new_episode_query_binding.rationale: Navigation-only no-arm task; preserve outcome, evidence and causal-uncertainty functions without presupposing delivery, failure or slowness. Original physical HEXAR queries remain archived separately.

closure_audit.scope: 54 packets from six development episodes; intact/irrelevant equality and masked controller-context removal. Full final runtime closure and adapter qualification remain required.

unique_request_policy.rule: Generate once per unique complete method request within each episode; identical intact/irrelevant aliases share output, failure and evaluation; no cross-episode or cross-method reuse.
